name: M/Y Coral Ocean
lede: Aboard the refurbished superyacht Coral Ocean, the aft decks are where everyone gathers. Recessed Platinum Electric Marine heaters let twelve guests dine outside on chilly evenings, all year.
data: Main deck aft and owner’s deck aft
Platinum Smart-Heat® Electric Marine · Platinum Electric Recess Kit

hero.caption: The covered aft deck, heaters recessed in the white ceiling. Bromic-published photograph from the case study.

Bromic-published photograph from the case study.

beats: Designed by Bannenberg & Rowell, with naval architecture by Lürssen, the recently refurbished yacht has two aft decks that each seat twelve – her most important gathering places, her captain says.
The outdoor decks had to be usable year-round, including for dining on chilly evenings, with even heat and few cold spots.

Through Bromic’s complimentary design service, a heating expert prepared a free 2D heat plan. Platinum Smart-Heat Electric Marine heaters were recessed with the Platinum Electric Recess Kit on both aft decks and run on a Wireless Dimmer Controller.
